function(_nova_json_get_string _json_text _key _out_var)
  set(_normalized "${_json_text}")
  string(REPLACE "\r" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REPLACE "\n" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REPLACE "\t" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REGEX MATCH "\"${_key}\"[ ]*:[ ]*\"([^\"]*)\"" _match "${_normalized}")
  if(_match)
    set(${_out_var} "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}" PARENT_SCOPE)
  else()
    set(${_out_var} "" PARENT_SCOPE)
  endif()
endfunction()

function(_nova_json_get_bool _json_text _key _default_value _out_var)
  set(_normalized "${_json_text}")
  string(REPLACE "\r" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REPLACE "\n" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REPLACE "\t" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REGEX MATCH "\"${_key}\"[ ]*:[ ]*(true|false)" _match "${_normalized}")
  if(_match)
    string(TOUPPER "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}" _bool_value)
    set(${_out_var} "${_bool_value}" PARENT_SCOPE)
  else()
    string(TOUPPER "${_default_value}" _default_bool)
    set(${_out_var} "${_default_bool}" PARENT_SCOPE)
  endif()
endfunction()

function(_nova_json_get_string_array _json_text _key _out_var)
  set(_result)
  set(_normalized "${_json_text}")
  string(REPLACE "\r" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REPLACE "\n" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REPLACE "\t" " " _normalized "${_normalized}")
  string(REGEX MATCH "\"${_key}\"[ ]*:[ ]*\\[([^]]*)\\]" _array_match "${_normalized}")
  if(_array_match)
    set(_array_payload "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
    string(REGEX MATCHALL "\"([^\"]+)\"" _items "${_array_payload}")
    foreach(_item IN LISTS _items)
      string(REGEX REPLACE "^\"|\"$" "" _value "${_item}")
      if(NOT _value STREQUAL "")
        list(APPEND _result "${_value}")
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()
  set(${_out_var} "${_result}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_nova_sanitize_identifier _raw _out_var)
  set(_value "${_raw}")
  if(_value STREQUAL "")
    set(_value "GeneratedPlugin")
  endif()
  string(REGEX REPLACE "[^A-Za-z0-9_]" "_" _value "${_value}")
  if(_value MATCHES "^[0-9]")
    set(_value "Plugin_${_value}")
  endif()
  set(${_out_var} "${_value}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

function(_nova_find_descriptor_by_id _extensions_root _dependency_id _out_path)
  set(_found_descriptor "")
  if(EXISTS "${_extensions_root}")
    file(GLOB_RECURSE _descriptor_files "${_extensions_root}/*.json")
    foreach(_descriptor IN LISTS _descriptor_files)
      if(_descriptor MATCHES "(^|/)Intermediate(/|$)" OR _descriptor MATCHES "(^|/)Binaries(/|$)" OR _descriptor MATCHES "(^|/)Install(/|$)")
        continue()
      endif()
      file(READ "${_descriptor}" _descriptor_json)
      string(STRIP "${_descriptor_json}" _trimmed_json)
      if(_trimmed_json STREQUAL "")
        continue()
      endif()
      _nova_json_get_string("${_descriptor_json}" "id" _descriptor_id)
      if(_descriptor_id STREQUAL "${_dependency_id}")
        set(_found_descriptor "${_descriptor}")
        break()
      endif()
    endforeach()
  endif()
  set(${_out_path} "${_found_descriptor}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

set(NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH "")
if(DEFINED PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH AND EXISTS "${PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH}")
  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH "${PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH}")
else()
  file(GLOB _descriptor_candidates "${NOVA_PLUGIN_ROOT}/*.json")
  foreach(_descriptor IN LISTS _descriptor_candidates)
    file(READ "${_descriptor}" _descriptor_json)
    string(STRIP "${_descriptor_json}" _trimmed_json)
    if(_trimmed_json STREQUAL "")
      continue()
    endif()
    _nova_json_get_string("${_descriptor_json}" "id" _descriptor_id)
    if(NOT _descriptor_id STREQUAL "")
      set(NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH "${_descriptor}")
      break()
    endif()
  endforeach()

  if(NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH STREQUAL "" AND _descriptor_candidates)
    list(GET _descriptor_candidates 0 NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH)
  endif()
endif()

if(NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH STREQUAL "")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "${NOVA_PLUGIN_FOLDER_NAME}: no plugin descriptor JSON found in '${NOVA_PLUGIN_ROOT}'.")
endif()

file(READ "${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH}" NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON)
string(STRIP "${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" _descriptor_trimmed)
if(_descriptor_trimmed STREQUAL "")
  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON "{}")
endif()

_nova_json_get_string("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "id" NOVA_PLUGIN_ID)
_nova_json_get_string("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "name" NOVA_PLUGIN_NAME)
_nova_json_get_string("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "targetName" NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME_JSON)
_nova_json_get_string("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "projectName" NOVA_PLUGIN_PROJECT_NAME_JSON)
_nova_json_get_string("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "outputName" NOVA_PLUGIN_OUTPUT_NAME_JSON)
_nova_json_get_string("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "exportsMacro" NOVA_PLUGIN_EXPORTS_MACRO_JSON)
_nova_json_get_bool("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "linkNovaCore" "true" NOVA_PLUGIN_LINK_NOVACORE)

_nova_json_get_string_array("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "dependencies" NOVA_PLUGIN_DEPENDENCIES)
_nova_json_get_string_array("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "publicIncludePaths" NOVA_PLUGIN_PUBLIC_INCLUDE_PATHS)
_nova_json_get_string_array("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "privateIncludePaths" NOVA_PLUGIN_PRIVATE_INCLUDE_PATHS)
_nova_json_get_string_array("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "extraIncludePaths" NOVA_PLUGIN_EXTRA_INCLUDE_PATHS)
_nova_json_get_string_array("${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_JSON}" "extraCompileDefinitions" NOVA_PLUGIN_EXTRA_COMPILE_DEFINITIONS)

if(NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME_JSON STREQUAL "")
  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME_RAW "${NOVA_PLUGIN_FOLDER_NAME}")
else()
  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME_RAW "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME_JSON}")

_nova_sanitize_identifier("${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME_RAW}" NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME)

  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_PROJECT_NAME_RAW "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}")

  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_PROJECT_NAME_RAW "${NOVA_PLUGIN_PROJECT_NAME_JSON}")

_nova_sanitize_identifier("${NOVA_PLUGIN_PROJECT_NAME_RAW}" NOVA_PLUGIN_PROJECT_NAME)

  "${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cpp"
  "${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cc"
  "${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIR}/*.cxx"
  "${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIR}/*.c"
)

if(NOT NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCES)
  message(STATUS "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: no source files found under '${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIR}', skipping target generation.")
  return()
endif()

# Mirror the disk hierarchy in Visual Studio (Solution Explorer)
source_group(TREE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}" FILES ${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCES})

add_library(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} SHARED ${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCES})

  set(_HOST_SRC_DIR ${HOST_PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR})

  set(_HOST_SRC_DIR ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR})
endif()

target_include_directories(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PUBLIC
  ${_HOST_SRC_DIR}/Source/Public
  ${_HOST_SRC_DIR}/Source/Public/Core
  ${_HOST_SRC_DIR}/Source/ThirdParty
  ${NOVA_PLUGIN_SOURCE_DIR}
)

set(_public_include_dirs)
foreach(_public_path IN LISTS NOVA_PLUGIN_PUBLIC_INCLUDE_PATHS NOVA_PLUGIN_EXTRA_INCLUDE_PATHS)
  if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${_public_path}")
    set(_resolved_public_path "${_public_path}")
  else()
    get_filename_component(_descriptor_dir "${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH}" DIRECTORY)
    set(_resolved_public_path "${_descriptor_dir}/${_public_path}")
  endif()

  if(EXISTS "${_resolved_public_path}")
    list(APPEND _public_include_dirs "${_resolved_public_path}")
  else()
    message(WARNING "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: include path '${_public_path}' not found at '${_resolved_public_path}'.")
  endif()
endforeach()

if(NOT "${_public_include_dirs}" STREQUAL "")
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _public_include_dirs)
  target_include_directories(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PUBLIC ${_public_include_dirs})
endif()

set(_private_include_dirs)
foreach(_private_path IN LISTS NOVA_PLUGIN_PRIVATE_INCLUDE_PATHS)
  if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${_private_path}")
    set(_resolved_private_path "${_private_path}")
  else()
    get_filename_component(_descriptor_dir "${NOVA_PLUGIN_DESCRIPTOR_PATH}" DIRECTORY)
    set(_resolved_private_path "${_descriptor_dir}/${_private_path}")
  endif()

  if(EXISTS "${_resolved_private_path}")
    list(APPEND _private_include_dirs "${_resolved_private_path}")
  else()
    message(WARNING "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: private include path '${_private_path}' not found at '${_resolved_private_path}'.")
  endif()
endforeach()

if(NOT "${_private_include_dirs}" STREQUAL "")
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _private_include_dirs)
  target_include_directories(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${_private_include_dirs})
endif()

set(_dependency_include_dirs)
if(NOVA_ENABLE_EXTENSION_DEPENDENCY_AUTOWIRE AND NOT "${NOVA_PLUGIN_DEPENDENCIES}" STREQUAL "")
  if(DEFINED HOST_EXTENSIONS_ROOT)
    set(_host_extensions_root "${HOST_EXTENSIONS_ROOT}")
  elseif(DEFINED HOST_PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR)
    set(_host_extensions_root "${HOST_PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/Extensions")
  else()
    set(_host_extensions_root "")
  endif()

  if(EXISTS "${_host_extensions_root}")
    foreach(_dep_id IN LISTS NOVA_PLUGIN_DEPENDENCIES)
      _nova_find_descriptor_by_id("${_host_extensions_root}" "${_dep_id}" _dep_descriptor)
      if(_dep_descriptor STREQUAL "")
        message(WARNING "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: dependency descriptor '${_dep_id}' was not found under '${_host_extensions_root}'.")
        continue()
      endif()

      file(READ "${_dep_descriptor}" _dep_json)
      _nova_json_get_string_array("${_dep_json}" "publicIncludePaths" _dep_public_include_paths)
      foreach(_dep_public_path IN LISTS _dep_public_include_paths)
        if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${_dep_public_path}")
          set(_resolved_dep_path "${_dep_public_path}")
        else()
          get_filename_component(_dep_descriptor_dir "${_dep_descriptor}" DIRECTORY)
          set(_resolved_dep_path "${_dep_descriptor_dir}/${_dep_public_path}")
        endif()

        if(EXISTS "${_resolved_dep_path}")
          list(APPEND _dependency_include_dirs "${_resolved_dep_path}")
        else()
          message(WARNING "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: dependency include path '${_dep_public_path}' for '${_dep_id}' not found at '${_resolved_dep_path}'.")
        endif()
      endforeach()
    endforeach()
  else()
    message(WARNING "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: host Extensions root not found; dependency include autowiring disabled.")
  endif()
endif()

if(NOT "${_dependency_include_dirs}" STREQUAL "")
  list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _dependency_include_dirs)
  target_include_directories(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${_dependency_include_dirs})
endif()

  set(NOVA_PLUGIN_EXPORTS_MACRO "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}_EXPORTS")
else()

endif()

# Output directory management
# We ensure that even if extensions are built individually, their artifacts go to
# the central binaries folder at the repository root.
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
	set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
	set(CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY)
	set(CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries")
endif()

set_target_properties(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
)

if(CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
  foreach(_cfg IN LISTS CMAKE_CONFIGURATION_TYPES)
    string(TOUPPER "${_cfg}" _cfg_up)
    set_target_properties(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PROPERTIES
      RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${_cfg_up} "${CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${_cfg_up} "${CMAKE_LIBRARY_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
      ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY_${_cfg_up} "${CMAKE_ARCHIVE_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY}"
    )
  endforeach()
endif()

  set(_output_base "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}")
else()
  set(_output_base "${NOVA_PLUGIN_OUTPUT_NAME_JSON}")
endif()

if(DEFINED BUILD_CONFIGURATION)
  set_target_properties(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "${_output_base}-${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}")
else()
  set_target_properties(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "${_output_base}")
endif()

if(DEFINED NOVA_CURRENT_PLUGIN_PATH)
  set_target_properties(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PROPERTIES FOLDER "Extensions/${NOVA_CURRENT_PLUGIN_PATH}/Source")
else()
  # Fallback for standalone builds or if the relative path isn't passed from host
  set_target_properties(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PROPERTIES FOLDER "Extensions/${NOVA_PLUGIN_FOLDER_NAME}/Source")
endif()

if(NOVA_PLUGIN_LINK_NOVACORE)
  if(TARGET NovaCore)
    # Native in-tree build
    target_link_libraries(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE NovaCore)
  else()
    # Out-of-tree or standalone build fallback
    set(_nova_hints)
    if(DEFINED HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR)
      list(APPEND _nova_hints
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/Libraries
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/Libraries/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/lib
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/lib/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}/lib
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/Binaries
        ${HOST_BUILD_OUTPUT_DIR}/Binaries/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
      )
    else()
      list(APPEND _nova_hints
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries/Libraries
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries/Libraries/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries/lib
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Binaries/lib/${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Intermediate/Build/lib
        ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/Build/lib
      )
    endif()

    find_library(NOVA_CORE_LIB
      NAMES
        NovaCore
        NovaCore-${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
        libNovaCore
        libNovaCore-${BUILD_CONFIGURATION}
      HINTS ${_nova_hints}
      NO_DEFAULT_PATH
    )

    if(NOVA_CORE_LIB)
      target_link_libraries(${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME} PRIVATE ${NOVA_CORE_LIB})
    else()
      message(WARNING "${NOVA_PLUGIN_TARGET_NAME}: NovaCore import library not found in expected host output paths.")
    endif()
  endif()
endif()
